records.title: A consonant cannot supply its own cause of destruction
Rai is a source-given negative control
Three P self-wish stems and one n-final P stem
Sannipāta does not suppress post-consonant sound reduction
Periphrastic and future checks across the same boundary

runtime_policy.document_check_scope: Five typed profiles, five full ten-lakāra grids, four direct gav/nāv source controls, rai and rājan controls; morphological versus sound-only loss distinguished and all 450 keys accounted. Static checks only; no grammar execution or full predecessor audit.

open_obligations: Wider semantic admission, independent source scans, accent/doubling and executable/native/calculator integration.
next_work: Build the shared Sanskrit phrase-to-predicate relation from the source roles, case witnesses and lexical purpose gates.
